title: FlashQLA: Efficient Context Parallelism for Gated DeltaNet
abstract: arXiv:2611.32039v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gated DeltaNet (GDN) achieves linear computational complexity through recurrent state updates, but sequential dependencies between chunks limit parallelism, particularly for long-context workloads with small batch sizes or limited head-level parallelism per GPU. We present FlashQLA, a context-parallel execution framework for GDN that exposes additional sequence-level parallelism while reducing boundary-state preprocessing overhead. FlashQLA reduces boundary-state preprocessing overhead through decay-aware preparation and extends sequence parallelism across GPUs with Dual CP, which shares summary computation across parallelism levels. Workload-adaptive Auto CP and CP-aware kernel co-design further improve execution efficiency. FlashQLA achieves $1.7\times$-$3.1\times$ forward speedup and up to $4.4\times$ backward speedup over Flash Linear Attention (FLA) on a single GPU. translated_title: FlashQLA：面向门控DeltaNet（Gated DeltaNet）的高效上下文并行方法
translated_abstract: 门控DeltaNet（GDN）通过循环状态更新实现了线性计算复杂度，但分块之间的顺序依赖限制了并行性，尤其是对于小批量或每GPU头级并行度有限的长上下文工作负载。我们提出了FlashQLA，一个面向GDN的上下文并行执行框架，它能够挖掘额外的序列级并行性，同时降低边界状态预处理的开销。FlashQLA通过衰减感知准备减少边界状态预处理开销，并通过Dual CP将序列并行扩展到多GPU，Dual CP可在不同并行层级之间共享摘要计算。工作负载自适应的Auto CP与CP感知的内核协同设计进一步提升了执行效率。在单GPU上，FlashQLA相比Flash Linear Attention（FLA）实现了1.7倍至3.1倍的前向加速以及高达4.4倍的反向加速。在八个GPU上，针对高达100万token的上下文长度，Dual CP实现...
tldr: FlashQLA是一个面向Gated DeltaNet的上下文并行执行框架，通过衰减感知准备、Dual CP、Auto CP和CP感知内核协同设计，挖掘序列级并行并降低边界状态预处理开销，在长上下文场景下实现了最高4.4倍的显著加速。
en_tdlr: FlashQLA is a context-parallel execution framework for Gated DeltaNet that exposes sequence-level parallelism and reduces boundary-state preprocessing overhead via decay-aware preparation, Dual CP, Auto CP, and CP-aware kernel co-design, achieving up to 4.4× speedup on long-context workloads.
